abstract: OBJECTIVE: Mature cystic teratoma of the ovary (MCT) is the most common ovarian cystic disease in young women. Although it is a rare occurrence, some cases develop malignant transformation (MT), which results in serious consequences. However, MT is currently diagnosed only by postoperative pathology in most cases. We have conducted a retrospective study in an attempt to seek the factor to diagnose MT from MCT prior to surgery. STUDY DESIGN: Eighty-one patients with MCT and 39 patients with MT were entered in this study. Patient's age, tumor size, serum CEA levels, and serum SCC levels were tested by the Mann-Whiteney U test. Sensitivity and specificity were calculated, and the most suitable point was searched from the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve. RESULTS: A significant difference was recognized in both patient's age and serum SCC level (P < 0.0001). For a patient less than 40 years old, the sensitivity to MT was 95%, and then the specificity to MT was 63%. When the standard value of the SCC level of the serum was established as 2.5 ng/ml, the sensitivity to MT was 80% and the specificity to MT was 94%. We apply two criteria at the same time (serum SCC levels less than 2.5 ng/ml and patient's age less than 40 years old). The sensitivity for MT was 77% and specificity was 96%. CONCLUSION: The combination of the two criteria which are patient's age (under 40 years old) and serum SCC level (under 2.5 ng/ml) was considered a suitable marker for differential diagnosis between MCT and MT. Further the possibility for MT is quite low when the patient is 39 years old or younger and the serum SCC level is under 2.5 ng/ml. When any patient satisfies this condition, laparoscopic surgery will be able to be planned safely.
abstract_ja: 目的: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(MCT)は若年女性で最も多くみられる卵巣嚢胞性疾患である。まれではあるが、悪性転化(MT)を生じ、重篤な結果をもたらすことがある。しかし、ほとんどの症例でMTは術後病理によってのみ診断されているのが現状である。われわれは、術前にMCTからMTを診断するための因子を探索する目的で後方視的研究を行った。研究デザイン: MCT患者81例とMT患者39例を本研究に組み入れた。患者の年齢、腫瘍径、血清CEA値、血清SCC値をMann-WhitneyのU検定で検討した。感度と特異度を算出し、受信者動作特性(ROC)曲線から最適な閾値を求めた。結果: 患者の年齢と血清SCC値に有意差が認められた(P<0.0001)。40歳未満の患者では、MTに対する感度は95%、特異度は63%であった。血清SCC値の基準値を2.5ng/mlとした場合、MTに対する感度は80%、特異度は94%であった。2つの基準を同時に適用した(血清SCC値2.5ng/ml未満かつ年齢40歳未満)。MTに対する感度は77%、特異度は96%であった。結論: 患者の年齢(40歳未満)と血清SCC値(2.5ng/ml未満)の2つの基準の組み合わせは、MCTとMTの鑑別診断に適したマーカーと考えられた。さらに、39歳以下で血清SCC値が2.5ng/ml未満の患者では、MTの可能性はきわめて低い。該当する患者では、腹腔鏡手術を安全に計画できると考えられる。
